shadows.name: subtle-elevation

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest Emerald primary action button with smooth hover elevation and scale click feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #40835c; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #356e4c; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Amber Button
components.description: Warm Amber secondary button used for active highlights and secondary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #e79b44; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #d48a35; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Clean white card surface with light border and hover depth.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px 0; color: #09090b; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #71717a; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(64,131,92,0.3); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input field with Forest Emerald focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Cari Surah atau Ayat..." />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #09090b; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #40835c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(64,131,92,0.2); }

components.name: Amber Active Badge
components.description: Warm amber status pill badge for active highlights and milestones.
components.css: .ds-badge-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(231,155,68,0.15); color: #d48a35; border: 1px solid rgba(231,155,68,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Kontaq embodies a serene, focused, and elevated digital sanctuary designed for Quranic study, daily reflection (tadabbur), interactive quizzes, and community engagement. The visual world balances rich natural Forest Green (#40835c) identity anchors with illuminating Warm Amber (#e79b44) accents.

rules.name: The Legibility First Rule
rules.body: Quranic text and Indonesian translations must maintain crisp contrast against background surfaces; decorative color fills should never compromise readability.

rules.name: The Dual-Language Line Height Rule
rules.body: Arabic scripture text must maintain a minimum line-height: 2em to prevent voweling marks (tashkeel) from overlapping or clipping.

rules.name: The State-Gated Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest. Ambient drop shadows appear exclusively in response to user interaction (hover, focus, or modal overlay).

dos: Do use 'LPMQ Isep Misbah' with line-height: 2em for all Arabic Quran scripture rendering.
Do apply smooth 12px radiuses for buttons, cards, and input fields.
Do use #40835c for primary brand framing and #e79b44 for interactive highlights, badges, and active states.
donts: Don't compress Arabic line-heights, which clips tashkeel diacritic marks.
Don't apply harsh black drop shadows; use soft ambient shadows for interactive hover states.
Don't introduce competing accent colors that disrupt the serene green and warm amber palette.
